User (5.0s): You can reach her tomorrow morning around eleven. I can pay the bill myself if you'd like.

Assistant (5.4s): Thank you. I will try again tomorrow at 11:00 AM. Goodbye!

Assistant (13.1s): Thank you for your time. Goodbye!

Assistant (13.5s): Thank you. Goodbye!
